title.zh-Hans: 全仓：为什么一笔亏损会影响别的仓位？

shots.visual_en: Two small position boxes are piped to the same tank; one leaks, and the other's level drops too.
shots.visual_zh: 两只仓位小盒子通过管道连到同一水箱；一个漏水，另一个水位也下降。
shots.onscreen_text_en: Why is the right one in danger too?

text.en: The loss is on the left one. Why is the right one in danger too?
text.zh-Hans: 亏的是左边这笔，右边怎么也变危险了？

shots.source_visual_zh: 两只仓位小盒子通过管道连到同一水箱；一个漏水，另一个水位也下降。

shots.visual_en: The tank is labelled '1,000 eligible collateral in one account (this example)'; the bank and an independent wallet sit outside the frame.
shots.visual_zh: 水箱标“本示例同一账户内1000合格抵押资产”，银行和独立钱包在边框之外。

text.en: Cross margin shares margin across positions, within what the rules allow. Here, say one margin pool holds 1,000. Several positions may depend on it, not just on what each was first assigned.
text.zh-Hans: 全仓会在规则允许的范围内共享保证金支持仓位。这里假设同一保证金池里有一千，多个仓位都可能依赖它，不是只盯各自最初分了多少。

shots.source_visual_zh: 水箱标“本示例同一账户内1000合格抵押资产”，银行和独立钱包在边框之外。

zh-Hans: 共享池：1,000 合格抵押资产（示例）

shots.visual_en: Position A's loss grows; shared equity drops; the buffer beside position B shrinks at the same time.
shots.visual_zh: 甲仓亏损扩大，共享权益降低，乙仓旁边的可用缓冲同步缩小。
shots.onscreen_text_en: One loss eats the shared buffer
shots.onscreen_text_zh-Hans: 一个亏损吃掉共享缓冲

text.en: One losing position can eat the buffer other positions rely on. Profits, losses, margin held for open orders, and the value of your collateral can all affect the same account's risk.
text.zh-Hans: 一个仓位亏损，可能消耗其他仓位依赖的风险缓冲。盈利、亏损、挂单占用和抵押品价值，都可能影响同一个账户的风险状态。

shots.source_visual_zh: 甲仓亏损扩大，共享权益降低，乙仓旁边的可用缓冲同步缩小。

en: A loss ↑ → shared equity ↓ → B buffer ↓
zh-Hans: 甲仓亏损 ↑ → 共享权益 ↓ → 乙仓缓冲 ↓

shots.visual_en: Side by side with isolated: isolated has clear walls; cross has a big pool under shared pressure. No 'safety champion' badge.
shots.visual_zh: 与逐仓并排：逐仓隔板清楚，全仓池容量大但共同承压；不出现“安全冠军”。

text.en: So cross margin is harder to liquidate, which makes it safer?
text.zh-Hans: 那全仓是不是更不容易爆仓，所以更安全？

text.en: Extra money can delay when one position hits risk handling. But it also puts more of your money on the line for the losses.
text.zh-Hans: 额外资金可能延后某个仓位触发风险处置，但也让更大范围的资金参与承担损失。

shots.source_visual_zh: 与逐仓并排：逐仓隔板清楚，全仓池容量大但共同承压；不出现“安全冠军”。

shots.visual_en: The 'cross margin scope' frame stops at the specified account and eligible collateral; an external bank card is not connected.
shots.visual_zh: “全仓范围”边框停在指定账户和合格抵押资产处；外部银行卡不被连入。

text.en: Cross margin doesn't let a platform automatically use all your bank cards or personal wallets. Which accounts and collateral count depends on the product rules. Complex collateral can also come with haircuts and its own price risk.
text.zh-Hans: 全仓不是平台能自动动用你所有银行卡或个人钱包。具体包括哪些账户和抵押资产，要按产品规则核对；复杂抵押组合可能还有折扣与自身价格风险。

label.zh-Hans: 范围：该账户 + 合格抵押资产

shots.source_visual_zh: “全仓范围”边框停在指定账户和合格抵押资产处；外部银行卡不被连入。

zh-Hans: 范围：该账户 + 合格抵押资产

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Under cross margin, is one position's risk always limited to its initial 100?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：全仓下，单个仓位风险是否一定只限于初始分配的100？

text.en: Not necessarily. It depends on the shared pool and the account rules.
text.zh-Hans: 不一定，要看共享池和账户规则。

text.en: Look at the whole pool, not just one position's box.
text.zh-Hans: 看整池资金，不要只看一个仓位框。

question.en: Under cross margin, is one position's risk always limited to its initial 100?
question.zh-Hans: 全仓下，一个仓位的风险总是只限于最初的100吗？

shots.source_visual_zh: 题目：全仓下，单个仓位风险是否一定只限于初始分配的100？

zh-Hans: 全仓：风险只限100？ 不一定

goal.en: Understand the shared risk of one margin pool, without mistaking cross margin for all your personal assets.
goal.zh-Hans: 理解同一保证金池的共享风险，不把全仓解释为所有个人资产。

page_cta.line_en: Make one virtual position lose in the simulator below and watch the shared pool.
page_cta.line_zh: 在下方模拟器里让一个虚拟仓位亏损，观察共享池的变化。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Let one virtual position lose, watch how risk changes across the same pool, and circle the assets that are not in this margin pool.
exercise.task_zh: 让一个虚拟仓位亏损，观察同池风险变化，并圈出不在该保证金池内的资产。
exercise.answer_en: Risk can spread across the same margin pool. It doesn't automatically cover all your personal assets.
exercise.answer_zh: 风险可扩展到同一保证金池；不自动覆盖所有个人资产。
